name: persistence_gt
caption: Paper B confirmatory G_t in local-bge-m3 / base-nf4, W=4,096. G_t = d_between(t) − d_within(t) on L2-normalised embeddings. The band is a seed-cluster bootstrap (resample seeds; descendants travel with their seed). Last-band G=0.1476 [0.0692, 0.1580]. This is not a UMAP cluster count.
alt_text: G_t versus turnover in local-bge-m3 / base-nf4.
limitations: A positive G_t is seed-conditioned ensemble persistence in this representation, not semantic-domain memory and not a metastable state. The lock construct is labelled separately and is not absorbing. INT8 is concordance, not a third headline.
